palettes.story: 清晨六点的湖面，水汽还浮着，蓝里透出一点淡淡的紫。

palettes.name: 樱花和纸
palettes.story: 一片樱花落在和纸信笺上，粉得很淡，像一声轻轻的叹息。

palettes.name: 靛蓝夜航
palettes.story: 深靛色的夜里，航船上只亮着一盏暖灯，安静地驶向远方。

palettes.name: 琥珀秋叶
palettes.story: 银杏落满石阶，琥珀与赭红叠在一起，像夹在旧书里的那片秋天。

palettes.name: 紫藤薄暮
palettes.story: 黄昏后的紫藤架下，淡紫与藕荷垂成一道帘，风里还有一线暖灰。

formats.compose: One complete isolated sticker character centered on a genuinely transparent square canvas. The entire silhouette, including ears, tail and feet, fits inside the central 72% of canvas height with at least 12% fully transparent padding on all four sides. No shadow, floor, scene, colored glow, or detached colored fragments.

formats.compose: One portrait manga page with five panels in three tiers. Tier 1: one wide panel across the full width. Tier 2: two panels, the left narrow and the right wide. Tier 3: two panels, the left wide and the right narrow. Read left to right, top to bottom. Thin black panel borders and white gutters of about 10px. Oval speech bubbles with tails in panels 1 to 4, a jagged shout bubble in panel 5. The main action sits in the largest panels, reactions in the small ones.

formats.zh: 日漫大格页（大格加小格）

safe_zone.note: 大格先读，再读下方三个小格

formats.compose: One portrait manga page. A dominant splash panel fills the top 60 percent of the page; below it three small equal panels in a row. Read the splash first, then the three small panels left to right. The splash carries the emotional peak with a large burst bubble or big lettering; the small panels carry setup and aftermath with small oval bubbles. Thin black borders, white gutters of about 10px.

safe_zone.note: 单列自上而下，格间留白 20 到 40px

formats.compose: A vertical webtoon strip in a single column: four full-width panels stacked top to bottom with generous white space between them, panels of varying height (tall, medium, wide, tall), allowed to bleed off the side edges. Read top to bottom. Floating rounded speech bubbles may overlap the panel edges; a narrator box in the first panel.

safe_zone.note: 公众号正文宽 900–1080；四周留 6% 边

formats.compose: An article summary illustration, read at phone width: a judgement-style title at the top, an optional one-line subtitle, then three to five labelled parts arranged in one clear horizontal structure (left-right comparison, a path of stations, three side-by-side columns or a radial hub). Each label sits next to one concrete prop that shows its meaning, connectors such as arrows, roads or bridges show how the parts relate, and the key word of the title is in the accent colour. A reader who skips the text should still get this section's conclusion from the picture alone.

safe_zone.note: 手机长图与转小红书；不进公众号正文

formats.compose: A vertical 9:16 article summary card for phones: a judgement-style title at the top, then three to five labelled parts arranged top to bottom in one vertical structure (rising steps, stacked cards or a vertical timeline), each with one concrete prop and a short note, connected by a path; the key word of the title is in the accent colour. The card alone should tell the reader what the section concludes.

safe_zone.note: 斜切、跨格、破格、出血

formats.compose: One portrait manga page with six panels of clearly different sizes and shapes, thin black borders and white gutters. Top: one wide establishing panel across the full width. Middle: a tall narrow panel on the left; on the right two panels split by a slanted dividing line tilted about 12 degrees, and the character in the upper one breaks out of the frame, hair and an arm overlapping the gutter. Bottom: a small square reaction close-up at lower left and a large panel at lower right that bleeds off the right and bottom page edges with no border, carrying the emotional peak. Every panel uses a different shot size or angle and the light changes with the time of day.
